sources.name: Grossglockner (Renault Route Planner — profil officiel)
sources.license: Proprietary — Renault internal reference (engineering reuse in CycleGen)
sources.citation: Renault Velocity Profile Grossglockner Route Planner (Velocity_Profile_Grossglockner_Route_Planner.xlsx). Sheet Velocity_Profile: TIME / VELOCITY / ACCELERATION / SLOPE; sheet Summery: 2-part Test/Simulation longitudinal & lateral limits.

zone_split.method: Abscisse curviligne s=∫v dt from Velocity_Profile. Cut chosen to match Summery 1st/2nd Part average speeds (29.74 / 54.2 km/h).

sources.notes: Official Renault velocity / accel / slope profile — no lat/lon (dynamics reference).

sources.license: Proprietary — EP-SIM / Renault engineering reuse in CycleGen

sources.notes: Profil v(t)+pente pour étude énergie CycleGen (véhicule XSPACE). Les colonnes couple/puissance EP-SIM sont dans epsim_xspace_grossglockner_energy_ref.csv (référence hors API).

sources.name: Grossglockner High Alpine Descent (Stress Freins)
sources.license: Open Data / Bikemap route reuse (engineering)
sources.citation: Bikemap route « Grossglockner High Alpine Road » #3666733. Final north valley descent only (~14 km, col/plateau → Ferleiten) for OEM brake-stress comparison with Renault Route Planner.
sources.notes: Velocity synthesized from grade + hairpin turn density for automotive brake-stress comparison (not raw bicycle GNSS speed). Elevation smoothed; slope from ~80 m baseline, clamped to ±14 % (realistic paved alpine max; raw GNSS grades are unusable). Spurs / out-and-back trimmed; segment chosen for length≈14 km and max elevation drop into the valley (Renault-comparable).

sources.name: AVL CRUISE — N90 Bourg-St-Maurice → Albertville (BCB)
sources.license: Proprietary reference (AVL Simulation_BCB) — engineering re-use, downsampled to 1 Hz
sources.citation: AVL CRUISE Simulation_BCB, trajet N90 Bourg-Saint-Maurice → Albertville (Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes). Sampled at 10 Hz originally, decimated to 1 Hz for CycleGen calibration.
sources.notes: N90 descent 54.5 km · Δz ≈ 519 m. Reference target for CycleGen kinematic calibration (RMSE_v ≤ 2.5 m/s, RMSE_a ≤ 0.25 m/s²).
